Recent: Effect, Fix Order.Struct ignoring symbol comparator fields; T3 Code, fix(server): RTF tracked deletions are left out of the extracted text; Material UI, [popover] Respect marginThreshold={null} at the right edge; React Native, Sort URLSearchParams names by UTF-16 code units; bat, Keep configuration active for option-like filenames; Synara, Show only installed providers in the model picker; Astro, Fix hydration with sparse array props; Slate, Honor insertion options in Editor.insertText and Editor.insertNode. Security: 3 vulnerabilities reported in Effect, one high, one moderate and one low severity. 92% merge rate: 197 landed and 17 declined by maintainers. PRs I withdrew, PRs maintainers took over, and PRs closed in cleanups or rewrites are not counted as declined.
